verdict.rationale: Aleph's own materials claim 'bi-directional Excel and Google Sheets workflows, including pull/push sync' and refer to its 'Excel and Google Sheets add-ins' backed by a live data layer that keeps models in sync. That covers each element of the story: an add-in, live pull, and push-back. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how push-back edits work (write-back targets, conflict handling, permissions), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing and llms.txt claims.
